name: Concerted changes in the pediatric single-cell intestinal ecosystem before and after anti-TNF blockade
description: Crohn’s disease is an inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) commonly treated through anti-TNF blockade. However, most patients still relapse and inevitably progress. Comprehensive single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) atlases have largely sampled patients with established treatment-refractory IBD, limiting our understanding of which cell types, subsets, and states at diagnosis anticipate disease severity and response to treatment. Here, through combining clinical, flow cytometry, histology, and scRNA-seq methods, we profile diagnostic human biopsies from the terminal ileum of treatment-naïve pediatric patients with Crohn’s disease (pediCD; n=14), matched repeat biopsies (pediCD-treated; n=8) and from non-inflamed pediatric controls with functional gastrointestinal disorders (FGID; n=13). To resolve and annotate epithelial, stromal, and immune cell states among the 201,883 baseline single-cell transcriptomes, we develop a principled and unbiased tiered clustering approach, ARBOL. Through flow cytometry and scRNA-seq, we observe that treatment-naïve pediCD and FGID have similar broad cell type composition. However, through high-resolution scRNA-seq analysis and microscopy, we identify significant differences in cell subsets and states that arise during pediCD relative to FGID. By closely linking our scRNA-seq analysis with clinical meta-data, we resolve a vector of T cell, innate lymphocyte, myeloid, and epithelial cell states in treatment-naïve pediCD (pediCD-TIME) samples which can distinguish patients along the trajectory of disease severity and anti-TNF response. By using ARBOL with integration, we position repeat on-treatment biopsies from our patients between treatment-naïve pediCD and on-treatment adult CD. We identify that anti-TNF treatment pushes the pediatric cellular ecosystem towards an adult, more treatment-refractory state. Our study jointly leverages a treatment-naïve cohort, high-resolution principled scRNA-seq data analysis, and clinical outcomes to understand which baseline cell states may predict Crohn’s disease trajectory.

labelsets.name: celltype
labelsets.description: In this paper we used an automated iterative subclustering algorithm to find hundreds of cell state clusters, after which we merged unsupported clusters and annotated each resulting cluster with a better-known cell subtype. The high-res cell state clusters are annotated as subtype.gene1.gene2, so in some cases we didn't directly name some commonly named subtypes, such as pericytes. When we run DE on the resulting subtypes, we find many canonical and scRNA-suggested marker genes.

labels.name: T
labels.rationale: T cells express the subunits of T cell receptor proteins - TRAC (the constant region) and CD3. T cells are a large, heterogeneous group here, and we haven't annotated subclusters except for with heuristic names for within-T marker genes (e.g. T.FOXP3.MKI67), so markers for T here are broad.

labels.name: Plsma/IgA
labels.rationale: Clear plasma cells with diversity of immunoglobulin transcript expression, but with higher IGHA

labels.name: NK
labels.rationale: There's no differential CD3 or TRAC expression here but plenty of cytotoxic markers, including KLR enzymes, which points to NK rather than T.

labels.name: Mstcl
labels.rationale: Mast cells are typically easy to identify in gut scRNAseq data as they cluster seperately and have high expression of tryptase (TPSA), chymase (CMA1), IgE receptors, and Histamine (HDC)

labels.name: EC
labels.rationale: Epithelial cells of the ileum are marked by keratins and S100G, a marker of the villus. In this dataset, we only mark epithelial stem cells, proliferating epithelial cells, and the rest of the epithelial cells as individual groups.

labels.name: Plsma/IgM
labels.rationale: These are clear plasma cells of B provenance based on SSR4/JCHAIN/MZB1 expression and their most differentially expressed genes is IGHM

labels.name: B
labels.rationale: Expression of major histocompatibilty complex II (HLA-DRA), BCR protein CD79A, MS4A1, which couples to both BCR and HLA, and CD74, which is in the BCR signaling pathway

labels.name: Plsma/IgG
labels.rationale: These are clear plasma cells of B provenance based on SSR4/JCHAIN expression and their most differentially expressed genes are all IGHG subunits, so we called them IGHG.

labels.name: Goblet
labels.rationale: These aren't highly DE for mucins but they have most of the other defining markers for Goblet cells, such as TFF3 and FCGP (which are in the mucin pathway) and ITLN1, a molecule secreted by Goblet cells that marks bacteria for clearance.

labels.name: Endth/Cap
labels.rationale: Capillary based on CD36. Endothelial based on pecam and claudin.

labels.name: DC
labels.rationale: These display much of the antigen presentation machinery (HLA, CD74), but without any expression of known canonical markers of DC subsets (XCR1, CD1c, CD123, CD303, CD304, CD21/CR2) we couldn't be more specific. CCR7 points to an activation state, which could be causing us to capture of markers of activation rather than lineage.

labels.name: Mono/Mac/DC
labels.rationale: This small cluster expresses antigen presentation machinery, dendritic cell markers, and SOD2 which points to macrohpages. It's possible it could be a DC, but it also shows high expression of CD48, so it could be an eosinophil. Here it is grouped generally with the other myeloid types because it is a small cluster of unknown myeloid provenance

labels.name: pDC
labels.rationale: This is a small cluster that shows antigen presentation machinery as well as distinct expression of IL3RA, a canonical pDC marker.

labels.name: cDC2
labels.rationale: This cluster shows many HLA molecules compared to all other clusters, but when compared to only other myeloid clusters, CD1C comes to the top of the list, and this is the canonical marker for cDC2's.

labels.name: TA
labels.rationale: These are clear epithelial cells based on OLFM4, KRT, EPCAM expression, but they also express some proliferative markers like MKI67 compared to other epithelial cells, so we called them transit amplifying

labels.name: Mac
labels.rationale: This cluster expresses CD68, the canonical macrophage marker, as well as several less specific myeloid/granulocyte markers such as LYZ and C1q. It also expresses CD74 and AIF1, which may point to activated macrophages

labels.name: Fibro
labels.rationale:
VIM - mesenchymal origin
ADAMDEC1 - often seen in gut fibroblasts
PDGFRA/B - fibroblast migration markers

labels.name: Prolif/EC
labels.rationale: These have high KRT8 and EPCAM as well as when compared to other EC, high histone and cell cycle machinery expression (STMN1, H2AFZ, TOP2A, UBE2C).

labels.name: MyoFibro
labels.rationale: This is a fibroblast which expresses myosin light chain proteins in addition to collagen and vimentin. These myosin and alternative actin genes are highest DE when comparing to the other fibroblast clusters.

labels.name: Mono
labels.rationale: This one has high AIF1, CD14, LYZ, FTL, all of which can be in macrophages. or monocytes. It is often difficult to discern macrophage from monocyte in gut data, but this one has higher CD14 as well as FCN1 and S100A8/9, so we went with monocyte

labels.name: Endth/Art
labels.rationale: endothelial based on VWF, PLVAP, claudin 5 CLDN5. When compared to other endothelial clusters, these highly express CALD1 and some GJA4 expression (DOI) - suggesting artery endothelial cells

labels.name: cDC1
labels.rationale: These are clear dendritic cells based on HLA, CD74 (MHC class 2 presentation molecules) and because they display increased XCR1 when compared to all other myeloid cells, we call them cDC1, because this is the marker that differentiates from cDC2

labels.name: Enteroendocrine
labels.rationale: CHGA/B expression makes these definitive EEC's.

labels.name: Mono/Mac
labels.rationale: This is another cluster of some difficult to determine group of monocyte or macrophages. It expresses markers for both, e.g. C1Q and LYZ (macrophage) but has highest expression of FTH1 and FTL, players in the ferritin blood cell iron scavenging pathway used generally by monocytes and macrophages to recycle RBCs. These may be closer to macrophage given predominance of catabolic pathways

labels.name: Endth/Mural
labels.rationale: This cluster expresses PLVAP, PECAM1, and CLDN5, but when compared to other endothelial cells is quite distinct with high DE NOTCH3 - which points to mural/perivascular cells. Could be a doublet of mural / endothelial cells.

labels.name: Endth/Ven
labels.rationale: PECAM1/PLVAP expressing endothelial cells. Compared to other endothelial cells, these display a high level of ACKR1, CPE, and MADCAM1 - attached DOIs suggesting these are venous endothelial cells.

labels.name: Endth
labels.rationale: Based on PECAM1, PLVAP, and CLDN5 expression, these are endothelial cells, but compared to other endothelial clusters, these are high for mitochondrial and housekeeping genes - they seem to be a lower quality cluster of cells which is why we give them a lower resolution annotation

labels.name: Prolif/Secretory
labels.rationale: Similar to the other "secretory" cluster, these are clear epithelial cells displaying SPINK1 and REG1A/B, but these also display STMN1 and other cell cycle markers.

labels.name: Paneth
labels.rationale: This is a keratin expressing epithelial celltype that is very strongly expressing DEFA6, DEFA5, and LYZ - matching canonical markers for Paneth cells.

labels.name: Glial
labels.rationale: Based on CRYAB, SPARC, CLU and PLP1 expression, these appear to be glial cells that are involved in some healing process. PLP1 places them as Glia and the others point to glial roles

labels.name: Myeloid
labels.rationale: These have a few general markers for dendritic cells and macrophages - AIF1 / CST3

labels.name: B/GC
labels.rationale: This cluster expresses B cell markers CD79B and SPIB in relatively low abundance compared to many housekeeping and proliferative markers, which is why we place them in the Germinal Center, as they could be B cell progenitors. Without AICDA, we decided to call them generally GC but not DZ.

labels.name: Secretory
labels.rationale: These are epithelial cells based. onKRT18 expression and they are not clearly fitting into goblet, EEC, paneth, or other specific secretory cell subsets, but they are high in SPINK1, REG1A/B, and LCN2. LCN2 and SPINK1 are secreted enzymes

labels.name: ILC
labels.rationale: This cluster was highest in KLRB1, which led us to name them generally ILC's, however it expressed several other strange markers that point to other general lymphocyte functions (ID2, KLRC1, TRDC) or interactions with epithelial cells (KRT86, KRT81)

labels.name: Mac/cDC1
labels.rationale: This small cluster expresses CD86, a dendritic cell marker, and many proliferative markers like STMN1, CENPF, and UBE2C, but not XCR1. It's possible it could be a cDC1 or more generally a proliferative dendritic cell despite lack of XCR1. Here it is grouped in with macrophages because it could be some kind of dendritic precursor but I'm not sure about this.

labels.name: Mac/DC
labels.rationale: Another cluster of high antigen-presentation structure expression that also displays other myeloid markers, in this case C1Q which points to some intermediate or doublet of macrophages and dendritic cells

labels.name: Endth/Lymph
labels.rationale: This cluster does not differentially express PECAM1, PLVAP, or VWF, but does have some claudin CLDN5 expression. It also expresses VIM, which points to fibroblasts, but one of the highest DE genes is LYVE1 - a gene recently suggested as a lymphatic vessel endothelial cell marker (see doi)

labels.name: Mono/cDC2
labels.rationale: This cluster is high for CD1C and antigen presentation markers but also high in other monocyte markers like LYZ, pointing to some intermediate stage between monocyte precursors/mature monocytes and cDC2's.

labels.name: Fibro/fDC
labels.rationale: These a vimentin-expression stromal cells, (which is why we call them fibroblasts), which have clear expression of CR1, CR2, and FCER2, placing them firmly as fDCs, despite how small a cluster they are!

labels.name: B/DZ
labels.rationale:
CD79B shows these are B cells
POU2AF1 and AICDA are germinal center markers for B cells, and AICDA points towards dark zone.
proliferation markers MKI67 and stathmin (STMN1) upregulated when compared to other B cell clusters show these have more of a proliferating signature, which points to dark zone B cells.
synonyms: germinal center dark zone B cell

labels.name: Mcell
labels.rationale: This is an epithelial subset (KRT8+) that shares some traits with the other secretory clusters, such as MARCKSL1, but one of its highest DE genes compared to other epithelial cells is CCL20, which is a maturation marker for M cells in the lymphoid follicle associated epithelia. It also expresses SPIB, a canonical marker of M cells It also expresses some TNF receptor signaling proteins, such as NFKBIA. These could be maturing follicle associated M cells or mature M cells, we are not sure.

labels.name: B/LZ
labels.rationale:
CD79A/B and MS4A1 shows these are B cells
RGS13 is the highest DE gene here compared to other B cells, and points to germinal center B. SERPINA9 is specific to germinal center B cells, and is especially prevalent in light zone B cells. CD40 and MARCKSL1 also point to B cell selection pathways.
The expression of RGS and SERPINA9 alongside lack of proliferation markers MKI67 and stathmin (STMN1) upregulated when compared to other B cell clusters point to light zone germinal center Bcells that are undergoing selection.
synonyms: light zone germinal center B cell

labels.name: EpithStem
labels.rationale: These are epithelial cells based on EPCAM and OLFM4, but also are highly expressing both ASCL2, a canonical intestinal epithelial stem cell marker, and SOX4 which also points to this categorization.

labels.name: T/NK/ILC
labels.rationale: These are lymphocytes with some TRAC/CD3 expression which are differentially high in ribosomal proteins, it can be hard to tell if they are T, NK, or ILC

labels.name: Mono/Mac/cDC2
labels.rationale: Another cluster of high antigen-presentation structure expression including CD1C and CLEC10A, definitive cDC2 markers, but is also high for other myeloid 'precursors' of cDC2s, both macrophages and monocytes, with LYZ, AIF1, CST3, and more

labels.name: T/NK
labels.rationale: These are a cluster. of cytotoxic lymphocytes that are hard to categorize as either T or NK cells (or NKT for that matter). They display markers for both lineages, including T cell receptor subunit C TRDC as well as many NK markers such as KLRD1, and they display generally activated cytotoxic markers in high relative abundance - CCL4, CD69, GZMA/K, and NKG7

labels.name: Tuft
labels.rationale: Keratin expressing epithelial cells that share some markers for secretory cells such as MARCKSL1 but also display canonical and newly suggested markers for tuft cells, SPIB, SH2D6, and LRMP.

labels.name: Glial/fDC
labels.rationale: These are definitely stromal cells based on CLU, VIM, CSTA, and probably glial cells based on very high expression of CLU, but they also have a definitive fDC marker in abundance: CR2
